period_note: SOLO / STANDALONE basis (the report also contains a Consolidated version including two subsidiaries, Islami Bank Securities Ltd and Islami Bank Capital Management Ltd, which is not used here per this dataset's solo-preferred convention). Source is a scanned/signed copy (Canon scanner) with no text layer; extracted via tesseract OCR and cross-validated internally: balance sheet ties exactly (total liabilities 1,927,668,455,994 + equity 71,378,688,449 = total assets 1,999,047,144,443; the 5 deposit sub-lines sum exactly to the deposits total; paid-up capital + statutory reserve + other reserves + retained earnings sum exactly to equity), and the P&L ties exactly (operating expense sub-lines sum to the total; operating income minus expenses minus provision minus tax reproduces PBT and PAT to within BDT 1 of rounding). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (the filing's own column header reads '01 January to March 2024'); for Q1 this is identical to the discrete quarter. 'Provision for taxation for the period' is the bank's full tax charge (current+deferred combined) subtracted directly from PBT to reach PAT; the separately-printed 'Deferred tax' line is a memo breakout of that total, not an additional deduction (verified: PBT 1,772,110,178 minus tax-provision 1,339,393,512 alone = reported PAT 432,716,666 exactly). The liabilities section lists 'Mudaraba Bond' (31,200,000,000) followed by 'Perpetual bond' (11,000,000,000) and 'Redeemable Subordinated Bond' (20,200,000,000); the latter two sum exactly to the former (11,000,000,000+20,200,000,000=31,200,000,000), so they are sub-components of the Mudaraba Bond line, not additive on top of it -- confirmed by the balance-sheet identity only closing when Mudaraba Bond is counted once. This interim filing does NOT disclose the absolute Classified Investment balance (unlike the annual report's 'Five Years Performance' table) -- only Note 11.1 'Provision for un-classified, classified investment and Off-balance sheet items' discloses the PROVISION held and its movement, which is included below as supplementary fields; classified_loans and npl_pct are therefore left out for this and other interim quarters rather than estimated. Note 11.1's comparative column is the full prior year (FY2023), not the prior quarter, so 'provision_classified_added' below is the cumulative Jan-Mar 2024 addition (for Q1 this is also the discrete-quarter addition).
